description: Stage-4 focus: make online variable control semantically effective at runtime, harden cross-platform CI script contracts, and advance operability/safety gates.

userStories.title: Make online variable control plane semantically effective at runtime
userStories.description: As a commissioning engineer, I want online variable operations to deterministically influence runtime evaluation (not audit-only) so diagnosis scripts can reproduce real logic behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: `sim-plc` online variable commands can bind BOOL/REAL variables to runtime-evaluated input channels via explicit binding contract
Missing/invalid variable binding fails fast with actionable error messages
Replay remains deterministic under tick-aligned scripts (same inputs -> same audit output)
Docs clearly describe variable binding format, runtime effect, and safety boundary
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Harden CI against cross-platform script mode and EOL drift
userStories.description: As a release owner, I want script executability and line-ending assumptions enforced in CI so Linux runners do not fail on permission/EOL regressions.
acceptanceCriteria: CI includes an explicit check that required gate scripts are executable in git metadata
Repository defines line-ending policy for shell scripts and keeps scripts LF-clean
Add a local/CI preflight command that fails on script mode or CRLF drift
Runbook documents how to reproduce/fix mode/EOL failures
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Promote real-board timing evidence to first-class HIL gate
userStories.description: As a safety/release engineer, I want board timing evidence thresholds to be a first-class HIL pass/fail gate so trace match and realtime evidence are enforced together.
acceptanceCriteria: HIL gate can fail on configurable realtime thresholds from board timing evidence
Gate outputs include concise timing verdict and threshold context in artifacts
Docs explain threshold selection and expected tuning workflow
Add regression tests for pass/fail timing threshold behavior
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Add provenance metadata for Class-D manual evidence attachments
userStories.description: As a safety auditor, I want Class-D manual attachments to carry provenance metadata so evidence origin and integrity are reviewable.
acceptanceCriteria: Class-D checklist/evidence supports attachment provenance fields (at least source path + optional digest/operator/time)
Verifier validates provenance field presence/shape for Class-D manual artifacts
Docs link provenance requirements to abnormal-exit workflow
Regression tests cover valid/invalid provenance payloads
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Provide commissioning-run command to execute standard nominal/fault rehearsal
userStories.description: As a field engineer, I want one command to execute the documented commissioning rehearsal flow so operator execution is consistent and less error-prone.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a `commissioning-run` command (or equivalent) that executes documented nominal and fault rehearsal chains
Command writes structured artifact index with per-step pass/fail outcomes
Commissioning playbook docs are updated to use the unified command
Regression tests verify artifact contract and command success path
